title: Brutus-Pell Connected Spectrum: High-Precision Finite-Sample Study
description: High-precision numerical data and reproducibility code for a pair-normalized connected interaction spectrum in the Brutus-Pell prime corridor p=72t^2+1. The archive contains 70-digit evaluations at X=2M,4M,8M for Q=199,997, a float64 precision-wall audit, finite-sample convergence diagnostics, and the first five-role ASTRAEUM verification artifact. No asymptotic law or physical interpretation is claimed.
